source_basis: Hospital experimenter confirmation, as communicated by the study authors.
source_statement: The participating hospitals identified the supplied U-TEG MA values and curves as instrument measurements.
runtime_input: U-TEG inputs are indexed on a 900-point grid at one-second intervals (15 minutes). The 5- and 10-minute windows cover the first 300 and 600 grid points. Processing masks identify the points retained for fitting. The runner loads saved early fits and stored full-record coefficients; parameter preparation precedes model evaluation.
source_qualification: All 478 retained amplitudes, curves and saved early fits match the corresponding entries in the previously audited 480-record version. Exact correspondence with reference-MA-based amplitude construction and full-record waveform transformations remains unresolved. SOURCE_VERSION_CHECK.json records the file-version comparison.
